source_commit_note: git HEAD at run time; the lane edits to this script are uncommitted

protocol.dev_scene_selection: archived split: sorted first-86 scenes intersected with oracle-feasible = 43; used for threshold selection only
protocol.dev_oracle_filter_disclosure: the dev scene set itself was defined with dev labels (candidate feasibility); deployment evaluation applies no filter
protocol.deployment_universe: eval_full = all 213 scenes outside dev, including the 117 oracle-infeasible ones; all256 adds the in-sample dev scenes
protocol.budget_rule: dev coverage closest to target, tie -> largest threshold
protocol.interpretation: dev-matched-policy extrapolation; eval coverage is not forced equal to dev coverage
protocol.threshold_correlation: the ~350-400 dev ladder thresholds per model, and the 25k-31k diagnostic breakpoints collapsing to ~1.7-1.9k action vectors, are nested correlated policies rather than independent replicates; no multiplicity correction is applied and none should be read in
protocol.net_benefit_units: one unit reward per successful scene minus one times archived action cost; illustrative utility, not football/business value

bootstrap.recomputation: each replicate recomputes each policy full ratio

protocol.per_scene_csv: FRONTIER_FULLSCENE_PERSCENE.csv holds the primary protocol only; scene_set dev43/eval213 partition all 256 scenes; acted=False rows carry selected_row=-1, action_cost 0 and net_benefit 0; score_used is the raw negative logit, or the calibrated score for isotonic_clean
protocol.sensitivity: dev_all = same first-86 scenes without feasibility filter; thresholds selected on it, evaluated on the remaining 170 scenes
